name: Hackathon One Page Judge
creator: Sua Choi
headline: Finds a project page, builds the one-pager, and predicts whether it can win.
public_summary: Paste a project name, project URL, or one-page description. This specialized research Agent extracts the project story, grades prize readiness, identifies judge-facing weaknesses, compares against public winner patterns, and gives concrete edits that make the submission easier to understand, trust, and award.
how_to_use: Paste a DeepSurge project URL, project name, or one-page description. Add the hackathon name, target track, judging criteria, sponsor technology, demo status, and any constraints if you have them.
result_summary: Returns source intake, a normalized one-page description, a candid readiness score, track-fit diagnosis, differentiation analysis, technical reality check, public prior-winner shortlist analysis, prioritized fixes, and a final revision plan.
result_sample: Review this DeepSurge project for the Walrus track and tell me if it can win: https://www.deepsurge.xyz/projects/[project-id]
